'''Nicholas Quixote Rogers''' (May 31, 1979 – May 3, 2010) was an American professional [[American football|football]] [[linebacker]] who played in the [[National Football League]] (NFL) and [[Arena Football League (1987-2008)|Arena Football League]] (AFL). He was selected by the [[Minnesota Vikings]] in the sixth round of the [[2002 NFL draft]].
